opening.argument: The video presents BitConnect as an investment and lending arrangement built around reinvestment, displayed profits, capital return, and affiliate rewards. The platform screen labels an option “LEND BITCONNECT / REINVEST” and shows “Active investment,” “Total earned,” “Lending profit,” and “Affiliate bonus,” while the speaker says, “you can start lending there's a reinvestment options.” He reports that $100 grew to nearly $190 and says, “so it works,” then links a giveaway to signing up for BitConnect and says interested viewers can use his description link for the affiliate bonus. He also says, “I'm not telling you to sign up for this,” and expresses uncertainty about one exchange claim, but those qualifications do not remove the promotional mechanism or the investment-return presentation.
